appstore.title: App Store
appstore.subtitle: Self-hosted apps, one-click install into an LXC container

golden.title: Golden LXC template
golden.desc: Automatically build the golden template (Debian 12 + Docker + Compose) on the selected node. App Store clones app containers from it.

appstore.disclaimer: This compose file runs as-is from a third-party repository. Review what will be installed.
appstore.delete_confirm: Delete app "{{name}}" and its LXC container?
appstore.update_confirm: Update "{{name}}"? A pre-update snapshot is taken automatically.
appstore.rollback_confirm: Roll back "{{name}}"? This ALSO reverts the app's DATA to the snapshot moment.
appstore.golden_missing: Golden LXC template is not configured. Set the APPSTORE_GOLDEN_TEMPLATE variable (see docs/golden-template.md).
appstore.no_credentials: No stored credentials for this app. Check the app logs or its documentation.
appstore.credentials_hint: Default login and password from the catalog plus secrets generated at install time. Change the password in the app after first login.

cluster.name_rule: Starts with a letter; letters, digits, hyphens; max 15 chars.
cluster.link0: Corosync link0 IP of the joining node (optional)
cluster.link0_hint: A dedicated network for corosync is recommended in production.
cluster.cluster_host: Cluster node address to connect to (optional)
cluster.cluster_host_hint: Private IP of the cluster node reachable over the corosync network. Leave empty to use its panel address (may be a public FQDN unreachable from a dedicated network).
cluster.rootpw_optional: root@pam password (if not saved on server)
cluster.join_unconfirmed: Join task started, but membership is not confirmed yet
cluster.node_clean: Node has no VMs/containers — ready to join.
cluster.guests_warning: Joining a cluster overwrites /etc/pve — all VMs/containers on this node will be lost. They must be backed up and deleted first.
cluster.no_backup_storage: No backup-capable storage found on this node.
cluster.node_ready: Node cleared and ready to join.
cluster.join_final_warning: The node will be joined to the cluster and its Proxmox interface will restart for a moment. This cannot be undone.
cluster.node_rootpw: root@pam password of the joining node
cluster.eject_warning: The node must be powered OFF before ejecting, and must not rejoin the same cluster network afterwards.
cluster.eject_panel_only: Only detach the panel entry (do not touch Proxmox)
cluster.eject_panel_only_hint: Use this when the node is not actually in the cluster (e.g. a previous join failed) or is unreachable for pvecm delnode.
cluster.two_node_quorum: A 2-node cluster loses quorum if one node fails. 3+ nodes or a QDevice is recommended for production.
cluster.import_hint: For nodes already clustered on the Proxmox side (outside the panel). This only links matching panel entries by IP/hostname — it does not run any pvecm operation.
cluster.no_real_cluster: This node is not part of a Proxmox cluster.
cluster.not_in_panel: Not added to the panel yet — add it as a server first.
cluster.linked_elsewhere: Panel entry is linked to a different cluster.

reset.forgot_subtitle: Enter your account email and we will send you a reset link.
reset.email_sent: If an account with that email exists, we have sent a link to reset your password. Check your inbox.
reset.invalid_text: This password reset link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
reset.set_subtitle: Enter a new password for your account.
reset.success_text: Your password has been changed. Redirecting to the sign-in page...

instances.owner_hint: Assign this instance to a user (admin only).
instances.saved_config_hint: Values stored by the panel at creation/reinstall time.
instances.migrate_no_targets: No other nodes available in the cluster.
instances.migrate_online_hint_running: Instance is running — live migration keeps it online during the move.
instances.migrate_online_hint_stopped: Instance is stopped — leave off for a regular offline migration.
instances.remote_migrate_desc: Move to an independent Proxmox cluster (not a node of the current one)
instances.remote_migrate_no_targets: No other servers configured with an API token. Remote migration requires the target server to use API token auth (not a password).
instances.remote_migrate_delete_source: Remove from the source cluster after a successful transfer
instances.ci_no_drive: This VM has no Cloud-Init drive — settings will only apply once one is added.
instances.ci_ip_required: Enter an IP address for static mode
instances.ci_reboot_hint: Cloud-Init applies changes on the next VM reboot.
instances.boot_order_hint: Devices are tried top to bottom. Disable a device to exclude it from booting.
instances.boot_none_enabled: No boot devices enabled — the VM will not boot.
instances.opt_agent_hint: Enables agent integration (needs qemu-guest-agent inside the VM).
instances.opt_tablet_hint: USB tablet for absolute mouse; disable to save resources on headless VMs.
instances.opt_kvm_hint: Disable only for nested virtualization without KVM support.
instances.opt_hotplug_hint: Allow hot-adding devices while the VM is running.
instances.cpu_type_hint: "host" gives best performance but blocks live migration between different CPUs.
instances.cpulimit_hint: Max host CPU cores the VM may use (0 = unlimited).
instances.cpuunits_hint: Scheduler weight relative to other guests (default 100).
instances.disk_detach_confirm: Detach and delete disk {{dev}}? This destroys its data.
instances.start_on_boot_hint: Automatically start this instance when the host node boots.
instances.startup_order_hint: Lower order starts first. Start delay waits before the next instance; shutdown timeout waits before force-off. Leave empty for defaults.
instances.protection_hint: Prevents the instance and its disks from being removed.
instances.apply_changes_note: Note: VM may need to be restarted for changes to take effect.
instances.resize_disk_hint: Disks can only be enlarged. Use the full target size.
instances.execute_script_hint: Runs via the QEMU guest agent (must be installed and running in the VM).
instances.search_placeholder: Search by name, IP, or VMID...
instances.deploy_completed_with_warnings: VM created, but some settings were not applied
instances.locked_hint: Locked by Proxmox — operation in progress
instances.snapshot_storage_hint: Snapshots require storage that supports them (qcow2, ZFS, Ceph/RBD, LVM-thin, BTRFS). They are not available on raw disks or plain LVM/iSCSI. The "Snapshots as Volume-Chain" option on LVM only enables snapshots for qcow2-format disks — an existing raw disk must first be moved to qcow2.
instances.snapshot_unsupported_storage: This VM's storage does not support snapshots. Use a disk on qcow2, ZFS, Ceph, LVM-thin or BTRFS — or use a backup instead.
instances.backup_no_storages: No backup-capable storages on this node

wizard.title: Create Instance
wizard.deploy_queued: Deploy task for "{{name}}" has been queued
wizard.no_lxc_templates: No CT templates found. Upload templates to Proxmox Storage first.
wizard.type_iso_desc: Blank QEMU/KVM VM for an OS install from an ISO
wizard.iso_node_hint: The ISO list comes from this node's storages
wizard.no_isos: No ISO images on this node. Upload one to a storage with the ISO content type first.
wizard.iso_extra_hint: Mounted as a second CD-ROM — for example virtio-win when installing Windows
wizard.disk_bus_windows_hint: The Windows installer will not see a VirtIO disk without drivers — pick SATA or attach virtio-win as the second ISO.
wizard.os_type_hint: Changing this presets BIOS, disk bus and network card
wizard.iso_ip_hint: The IP is only reserved in IPAM — there is no cloud-init here, so enter it manually in the installer.
wizard.iso_next_steps: The VM boots from the ISO. Open the console to run the installer; when it is done, unmount the ISO and put the disk first in the boot order.
wizard.iso_download: Download an ISO to this node

nodes.title: Servers
nodes.auth_error_hint: The server is reachable but rejected the credentials (HTTP 401). Check the API token or password — this usually means the token was revoked or replaced, e.g. after the node joined a cluster.
nodes.auth_mode_auto: Login and password (panel creates an API token)
nodes.auth_mode_auto_hint: The password is used once to create an API token. From then on the panel works through the token, which you can revoke in Proxmox at any time.
nodes.switch_to_token_confirm: Create an API token for server "{{name}}" and switch the panel to it? The stored password is used.
nodes.auto_create_token_hint: An API token will be created on the Proxmox server automatically. For a cluster, all nodes will be added.
nodes.auto_fields_required: Name, host and password are required

netif.err_bad_cidr: Enter the IP in CIDR format, e.g. 10.0.0.5/24

netif.apply_confirm: Apply pending network changes on this node? Active connections may be interrupted.
netif.revert_confirm: Discard all pending network changes on this node?

hw.platform_hint: Hardware changes take effect after the VM is powered off and started again.

hw.stop_first: Power off the VM to change passthrough
hw.running_lock: The VM is running — passthrough devices cannot be added or removed. Power off the VM.
hw.efi_required_hint: The EFI disk will be created automatically. Choose a storage for it.
hw.err_efi_storage: Select a storage for the EFI disk
hw.add_pci_description: Will be added as {{key}}. The VM must be powered off.
hw.pci_hint: PCI passthrough requires IOMMU (VT-d / AMD-Vi) enabled on the host.
hw.disk_used_warn: Disk is in use ({{used}}) — passthrough may cause data loss.
hw.disk_passthrough_hint: The disk is given to the VM exclusively via a stable /dev/disk/by-id/ path. Bound to this node — migration to another node is not available.
